hero.description: CCI India connects businesses, investors, government and innovators into a single, living economic ecosystem — championing policy advocacy, business expansion, strategic partnerships and investment facilitation across the country.

about.description: CCI India is an autonomous organization mandated for policy advocacy and diversified economic growth — drawing its strength from diverse regional chambers of commerce and industry across states, and serving members from India's private and public corporate sectors and multinational companies.

quickStats.label: Est. as a chamber for Corporate India

items.text: As a representative organ of Corporate India, CCI India articulates the genuine needs and interests of its members, working to impact policy and legislation so as to foster balanced economic, industrial and social development.

To empower Indian enterprise with the knowledge that catalyses growth in a technology-driven global market — helping members upscale, align and emerge as formidable players in their respective business segments.

cta.label: Read the full story, mission & leadership

pillars.title: Policy Framework
pillars.description: A structured set of guidelines and principles that helps organizations and government bodies guide decision-making and ensure consistency in action — the foundation for planning, implementing and evaluating policy.

pillars.title: Tangible Business Expansion
pillars.description: A clear, measurable strategy to grow business by doubling Gross Merchandise Value and Gross Merchandise Turnover — focused on increased sales and faster inventory turnover.

pillars.title: Strategic MoUs & Partnerships
pillars.description: Formalizing partnerships through Memorandums of Understanding with central and state governments, PSUs, ministries and departments — to collaborate on projects, share resources and align objectives for mutual benefit.

pillars.title: Funding & Investment Facilitation
pillars.description: Securing financial resources from Alternative Investment Funds, family offices, sovereign wealth funds and inter-governmental and government agencies — while exploring private debt and impact investing.

councils.description: From agriculture to aviation, healthcare to hydro power — CCI India's councils bring together stakeholders from every corner of the Indian economy.

whatWeDo.description: CCI India offers a bouquet of value-added services to its members and industry as a whole — building platforms for exchange, networking and new business generation. Hover a node to trace a connection.

footer.description: CCI India is the voice of India's business and industry. From influencing policy to encouraging debate, engaging with policy makers and civil society, CCI India articulates the views and concerns of industry.

footer.ctaDescription: Whether you are a business seeking expansion, an investor pursuing opportunity, or a policymaker shaping the future — CCI India is your bridge to the ecosystem.
